github.name: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
github.desc: 一种用于多阶段安全审计的编码代理技能，其审计结果经过独立验证且可机读
github.desc_en: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings

github.name: ruvnet/ruflo
github.desc: 🌊 原生代理框架。部署智能多玩家群集，协调自主工作流，并构建对话式人工智能系统。具备自适应记忆、自学习智能、联邦计算、向量RAG集成，以及原生支持Claude Code / Codex / Hermes等众多集成功能
github.desc_en: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated

github.name: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
github.desc: 一个开源插件仓库，主要供知识工作者在 Claude Cowork 中使用
github.desc_en: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork

github.name: stablyai/orca
github.desc: Orca 是管理代理集群（例如 Grok Bot、Claude Code）的理想平台。您可以使用自己的订阅运行任何编程代理。支持桌面端、移动端和远程运行时环境。
github.desc_en: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

github.name: heygen-com/hyperframes
github.desc: 编写 HTML。渲染视频。专为代理商打造。
github.desc_en: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.

github.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
github.desc: 将任何代码库（包括其文档、SQL 模式、配置文件和 PDF 文件）转换为可查询的知识图谱。一款适用于 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 和 Gemini CLI 的 /graphify 技能：本地确定性 AST 解析，每条边均附有说明，无需向量存储。
github.desc_en: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

github.name: akitaonrails/ai-memory
github.desc: 用于代理编码CLI的长期存储解决方案，以及促进不同代理供应商之间交接的解决方案
github.desc_en: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors

github.name: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
github.desc: 功能最强大且模块化的扩散模型图形用户界面（GUI）、API 和后端，采用图/节点接口。全球最快的本地推理引擎。
github.desc_en: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.

github.name: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
github.desc: 由 Anthropic 管理的、收录优质 Claude 代码插件的官方目录。
github.desc_en: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.

github.name: vllm-project/vllm
github.desc: 一款面向大型语言模型（LLMs）的高吞吐量、内存高效推理解析与服务引擎
github.desc_en: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs

github.name: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
github.desc: 一个用于改进 Claude Code 行为的 CLAUDE.md 文件，该文件源自 Andrej Karpathy 对大型语言模型（LLM）编码陷阱的观察。
github.desc_en: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.

ai.title: mizorewww/laya-mlx
ai.desc: 适用于 Laya 类型化决策模型的原生 MLX 运行时——在 M3 Max 上完成简短决策仅需 7–14 毫秒。无需文本生成、PyTorch 或云 API。
ai.desc_en: Native MLX runtime for Laya typed decision models — 7–14 ms short decisions on M3 Max. No text generation, PyTorch, or cloud API.

ai.title: qwdwqfwq/topconf-paper-figure-gallery
ai.desc: 精选自ICLR、ICML、NeurIPS、CVPR、ACL、AAAI（2023-2026年）的3,516张图1/预览图，附带分级徽章，并采用FigureForge检索增强型图稿绘制技术
ai.desc_en: 3,516 curated Figure 1 / teasers from ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, CVPR, ACL, AAAI (2023-2026), with tier badges and FigureForge retrieval-augmented figure drafting

ai.title: receptron/laya
ai.desc: 通过 ONNX Runtime，在 Node.js / TypeScript 环境中运行 Laya——这款开源的、与 Jev 兼容的 System-1 决策模型
ai.desc_en: Run Laya, the open-source Jev-compatible System-1 decision model, from Node.js / TypeScript via ONNX Runtime

ai.title: wfzyx/von
ai.desc: 开源的 System One 决策模型。响应时间低于 15 毫秒，非自回归，可直接替代 TypeSafe Jev 的本地解决方案。
ai.desc_en: The open-source System One decision model. Sub-15ms, non-autoregressive, local drop-in alternative to TypeSafe Jev.

ai.title: TrenTorch/TrenTorch
ai.desc: 不要死记硬背机器学习。要从第一性原理出发去理解它，包括推理、CUDA、深度学习、数据科学和强化学习。
ai.desc_en: Don't memorize ML. Understand it from first principles including Inference, Cuda, Deep Learning, Data Science and Reinforcement Learning

ai.title: strands-labs/strands-decider
ai.desc: 一个适用于主动型工作流的小型、快速决策模型，即“系统一”模型。它能在比大型语言模型（LLM）更快的速度下在选项间进行选择或在量表上进行评分，并且对每项决策都提供经过校准的置信度。
ai.desc_en: A small, fast decision model, or system one model, for agentic workflows. Pick between options or rate on a scale faster than an LLM, with a calibrated confidence on every decision.

ai.title: AbdelStark/awesome-typesafe-jev
ai.desc: 《Awesome Jev》：一本基于源代码的《TypeSafe》System One 模型实用指南，包含 SDK、实时演示、代理工具以及独立评估报告。
ai.desc_en: Awesome Jev: a source-backed field guide to TypeSafe's System One model, with SDKs, live demos, agent tools, and independent evaluations.

ai.title: muellerberndt/cadence
ai.desc: 一个从真实体验中学习的大脑。默认启用“系统1”：感知、记忆、可塑性和行动。可选的“系统2”用于自我观察和缓慢的修正。
ai.desc_en: A brain that learns from live experience. System 1 by default: perception, memory, plasticity and action. Optional System 2 for self-observation and slow corrections.

ai.title: Adkid-Zephyr/oral-paper-skill
ai.desc: 向顶会优秀论文学科研｜Oral Paper Skill — 从 883 篇 Oral 论文摘要中“蒸馏”共通做法，用于论文对照改进与学习复盘 · Skill + prompt pack (CN/EN). Learn from 883 Oral paper abstracts to improve your research and writing.

ai.title: realmyang/MLView
ai.desc: 由您的编码助手（Copilot、Codex 或 Claude Code）编写、并在 VS Code 中打开的、交互式且与源代码关联的机器学习工作流图。
ai.desc_en: Interactive, source-linked ML workflow diagrams written by your coding assistant (Copilot, Codex or Claude Code) and opened in VS Code.

ai.title: fstandhartinger/jevbench
ai.desc: Benchmark Heaven 推出的 JevBench：一款针对 AI 决策模型的基准测试和排行榜工具，用于衡量决策类型准确率、校准、延迟和成本。
ai.desc_en: JevBench by Benchmark Heaven: benchmark and leaderboard for AI decision models, measuring typed decision accuracy, calibration, latency and cost.

ai.title: Heman10x-NGU/openJev-verdict-2.0
ai.desc: 经过调优的 151M 非自回归决策引擎在 LocalLLaMA/typed-decisions 数据集上超越了 TypeSafe Jev & Laya（准确率 77.10%，布里尔系数 0.0636，误分类率 0.0144）
ai.desc_en: Calibrated 151M Non-Autoregressive Decision Engine beating TypeSafe Jev & Laya on LocalLLaMA/typed-decisions (77.10% acc, 0.0636 Brier, 0.0144 ECE)

ai.title: Simreal-AI/Simreal-MLBench
ai.desc: [公开预览] 外部评分型自主机器学习研究基准：60个任务，真实竞赛的 ground truth。开放协议，运营式评估。
ai.desc_en: [Public preview] Externally scored agentic ML research benchmark: 60 tasks, real competition ground truth. Open protocol, operated evaluation.

ai.title: ceyyy427/finathink
ai.desc: Finathink — 一款用于可审计的特定时点研究、数学学习及受限投资组合分析的金融研究优化工具。
ai.desc_en: Finathink — Financial Research Optimizer for auditable, point-in-time research, mathematical learning, and constrained portfolio analysis.

ai.title: Fazmin/AILearningGuide
ai.desc: 一款交互式桌面应用，包含 51 个实验，涵盖机器学习基础、Transformer 模型、RAG、智能体、微调和量化等内容。
ai.desc_en: Interactive desktop app with 51 labs covering ML fundamentals, transformers, RAG, agents, fine-tuning and quantization and more.
